pages.notes: Plan 2 called the half-open c-file open and had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8 and ...Rxc3. Reworded plan 2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Classical Attack
pages.notes: The overview and plan 1 described a Yugoslav-style f3, g4, h4 storm and long castling for the Classical Attack, where White castles short with Be2; plan 1 also had Bxh6 with no pawn on h6. Rewrote the overview and both plans.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Classical Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a pawn storm in front of White's own castled king; plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.notes: Plan 1 had an h4-h5-hxg6 route; plan 2 had ...Rc8 and ...Rxc3. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling in plan 4.
